findings.area: Student Progress leaderboard abbreviated names (server shortName)
findings.title: The abbreviation takes the first code point of the last name token, so a last name that starts with ZWSP, RLM, RLO or a combining mark yields an invisible initial: two classmates both show as "Eve ." and one as "Sam ." (next to a real "Sam K."), losing the only distinguishing letter
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/mkbidi2.mjs + /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/mklbbidi.mjs + /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/lbbidi_ui.mjs, screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/shots/lbbidi_small.png (rows "Eve .", "Eve .", "Sam ."). API rows: "Eve \u202e.", "Sam \u200b.". U+200B and U+200F are accepted by registration (only U+202x/2066-2069 are refused).
findings.repro: Student named "Sam \u200bK" (registers 201) in a class with XP, view the leaderboard as a classmate.
findings.expected: Initial of the first visible character ("Sam K.").
findings.fix_hint: be/src/game.ts shortName (~line 790): strip \p{Cf} and marks before picking the initial, and take the first grapheme, not the first code point (emoji ZWJ sequences are cut too).

findings.area: Student detail normalizer (historyTotal and cross-field consistency)
findings.title: historyTotal is only checked as non-negative: 27.5 prints "Showing the latest 20 of 27.5 attempts", 1e21 prints "of 1e+21 attempts"; a value below the list length is ignored silently; null (a natural "unknown") fails the whole page with "Invalid server student detail payload: historyTotal". Other cross-field contradictions are displayed, not rejected: level 0, missionsCompleted 9 with labs summing to 4
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/thist.mjs (variants totalFrac/totalHuge/totalNull) and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/tcross.mjs (detailXpLevel "Level 0", detailMissionsVsLabs "9 missions completed"), screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-C/shots/hist_totalFrac.png. findings.repro: Route GET /classes/:c/students/:id through page.route and edit the JSON.
findings.expected: Integer historyTotal >= history.length, optional-or-absent; contradictions raise the unexpected-response alert.
findings.actual: Invalid figures rendered as if they were data.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/faculty.ts normalizeStudentDetail: Number.isInteger + >= history.length (or treat null as absent), level >= 1, student.missionsCompleted === sum(labs.completed); same for studentsCompleted <= cohort.students in normalizeFacultyDashboard.

C-04 describeError: 224 faculty scenarios (8 endpoints incl. PUT x 28 status/body variants: 400/403/404/408/409/413/418/422/429/5xx empty and JSON, html/null/array/empty/invalid JSON 200, abort, 401) plus 30 settings-banner scenarios: always exactly one role=alert, no raw 'Request failed (n)', Retry recovers, no console errors beyond the browser's own 'Failed to load resource' (two per request in dev because of StrictMode); 401 ends in automatic recovery. 429: Retry-After is honoured only when the header is CORS-exposed (the API sends no Access-Control-Expose-Headers; the API's own 429 carries details.retryAfterSeconds so it is unaffected; only a proxy's empty 429 in a cross-origin setup falls back to 'Please wait a moment'); with the header exposed 30 s -> 'Try again in 30 seconds', HTTP-date -> 87 seconds. C-05 content review merged alert: 16 scenarios x 2 viewports (tcr13.mjs): one alert, 'The list could not be refreshed ... Retry', after Retry focus on h1 and 'The list below shows what the server recorded.' replaces it; clean 4xx keeps 'Could not update'. Minor, not filed: an empty-bodied 409 on the status PUT says 'Reload the page, then try again' although the page already re-read the list. Backend through the UI: leaderboard total is the same for every viewer (mkboard.mjs: 26 students, ties, 3 zero-XP; all viewers see total 23; rank 1,2,2,4,...); ties and >20 rows render correctly; unranked viewer: see R13-C-01/02. class_name_taken, the 50-class cap (51st: 409 class_limit_reached) and teacher name rules (i/l/1 and 0/O merged, bidi refused, (teacher #n) refused, Hangul filler folded) were exercised through the API (tnames.mjs, mkteacher.mjs): no UI path sends names or creates classes, so none is reachable from the browser; 50-class picker (incl. 80-char, RTL, emoji names) usable at 320/375/768/1440 (t5_faculty_ui.mjs, 0 issues, shots/f_small_many5.png). Numeric integrity: audit.mjs recomputed from c.db and raw API ~8,500 figures (demo classes of 38 and 8 students, my cohort with 0/3/6/9/10 missions, a 0-XP student, a 20%-accuracy student, hints, wrong answers, 27 replays, 26-student tie class, 50-class teacher, bidi class): roster, student detail, dashboard, profile, lab results, leaderboard (new semantics), class analytics, per-mission success/started/completed, hardest mission, labs: 0 mismatches (3 'issues' in the board class are my own check mis-modelling ties beyond the top 20; the API ranks are right). Browser: t4/t5/t9/tstud compare UI text with API for every student/teacher surface at 4 viewports: no NaN/undefined/null/[object Object]/Infinity, 9 vs 10 missions and 3 vs 4 labs consistent ('9 of 9 standard missions, Master tracked separately', '3 of 3 standard labs'), axe 0, one h1, no hscroll, no console errors. Staleness/permissions/privacy: delayed analytics/roster/detail responses with rapid class and student switching never show the wrong class (tstale.mjs, both orders); switching to the student guest while a faculty request is in flight leaves no faculty content, alert or console error (tswitch.mjs); 401/403/404 matrix on every faculty route (none/bad token 401, student 403 wrong_role, other teacher 404, bad ids 400/404), no e-mail/hash/join-code keys in teacher payloads (tperm.mjs). Text-spacing override at 320/375 no clipping; reduced motion stops the spinner; sidebar nav is 41 px high on a touch tablet (documented r11, not re-filed). Could not break: focus after Retry, merged alert, describeError matrix, stale cross-class data, numeric parity, privacy, historyTotal absent/present, completedAt 0/huge/float/string (string and negative are rejected by the normalizer, 9e15 drops the date silently, 0 shows 1970).
